hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint "$f" 2>&1 ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */package-lock.json|package-lock.json|*/yarn.lock|yarn.lock) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Lock files are managed by npm/yarn directly \u2014 edit package.json and reinstall instead."}}';; esac; }
